mechanism_hypothesis: In low-redundancy regimes, the fixed construction cost (intervention audit + family validation) dominates the benefit from certificate replay because cache hits are rare. By deferring construction until we observe enough cache pressure, we avoid the overhead when reuse is unlikely and pay it only when justified by observed hit rate.
mechanic_description: Adaptive lazy construction: observe the first N tasks with simple structure-keyed caching, compute the observed hit rate, and only trigger the intervention audit + family validation if the hit rate exceeds a threshold that makes the construction cost worth paying. Below threshold, continue with raw solving.
parameters_justification: observation_window=48 (20% of 240 tasks) provides a stable estimate of hit rate while leaving enough runway for construction payoff. activation_threshold=0.35 means we trigger construction if observed hits exceed 35% of the window, indicating enough redundancy to amortize the fixed cost.

evaluation_gates.honesty: charge full cost of observation period, threshold check, and construction (even if degradation to raw occurs)
evaluation_gates.completeness: must evaluate against same parent controls as sq3_successor (RAW, SURFACE_HASH, STRUCTURE, FAMILY_CERTIFICATE)
evaluation_gates.cost_accounting: all stage costs (observe, threshold_check, construction, solve, verify) must be charged to meter

success_criteria.primary_cell_positive: net_advantage CI excludes zero from above in at least 3 low-redundancy cells (scale x redundancy where redundancy <= 0.5)
success_criteria.aggregate_positive: aggregate net_advantage CI excludes zero from above OR straddles zero with positive mean
success_criteria.no_regression: must not lose net_advantage in any high-redundancy cell where FAMILY_CERTIFICATE_QUOTIENT was positive
success_criteria.honest_terminal: if gates not met, report EXTENDED_REGIME with next lever (never falsify data)

next_levers_if_terminal: partial_certificate_composition: compose fragments of prior certificates to cover novel queries
certificate_generalization: lift certificate to query family with soundness proof obligation
verify_order_adaptation: defer verification until confident about certificate validity
